decisions.reason: SOL drops 거금 and adds unsupported 'nicely'.
'Hardly know what to do with myself' is more natural for 몸 둘 바를 모르겠네요 without changing meaning.
BASE keeps 그래도 as 'Even so'; SOL's 'government official' over-specifies 벼슬하시는 분.
편하게 부르시라니까 is the repeated instruction to address him casually, not a vague 'feel free'.
'Then shall I' is the natural spoken 그럼; the versions are otherwise equal.
통성명 is a mutual exchange, and SOL drops 시선이 이쪽을 향했다.
묵직한 is a heavier voice, not a more dignified one.
개인의 위신 is personal dignity, and 망신 is humiliation rather than mere embarrassment.
Identical meaning; adverb placement is indistinguishable.
Keeps the 'properly' callback and the 정도가 아니라/도 'even' beat.
SOL drops 여기 from 여기 진 공자.
'Simply wouldn’t let him go' is tighter spoken English for 도무지 놔줄 생각을 안 하시더라니까요.
마음에 쏙 드신 makes His Highness the one taken with the brother; SOL reverses agency.
Drops the needless comma and tightens the parallel 'strong... and has'.
'Ahem' and 'no one would be surprised' naturalize 으흠 and 이상하지 않아요 without changing the claim.
Splits the cause and Hong Jin’s reaction into a clearer sequence while keeping the same beats.
'That joke goes too far' is the idiomatic reading of 농담이 너무 심하시다.
우습게 보다 is making light of him, not taking him for a fool.
싸해진 is cold, not frigid, and 헛기침 is giving a cough, not merely coughing.
진 공자 정도라면 is 'someone like,' not the narrower 'a man like'.
The line addresses 소가주님, not 'Lesser Family Head Jin'.
'Overcome with emotion' naturalizes 감격에 찬 얼굴로 without the body-part calque.
Preserves 혓바닥 놀리는 솜씨 as skill with his tongue rather than generic 'way with words'.
여기서 이럴 게 아니라 is not 'stand around,' and 술이라도 한잔 is having a drink, not sharing one.
어쩌죠? is playful 'what should I do?,' not the stiffer 'what a predicament'.
The punchline is 없어서 못 먹어요, not a gloss that he can never get enough.
쿵짝 잘 맞는 is that they click, not that they play off each other.
SOL adds staring after them, then turning; the source has 나를 바라봤다 only.
'Really' and 'truly' are indistinguishable here.
'I never imagined' fits the trailing 줄은 better than 'I didn’t know'.
맞장구까지 다 쳐 준 is playing along with the whole routine, not every word.
'Wearing a sour expression' is the more natural rendering of 썩은 표정.
은근슬쩍 is a subtle, sneaky stroke, not a casual one.
'Flung' matches 내팽개친, and the sentence break into the following speech is cleaner.
'To attend to' is padding on 중요한 볼일이 있어서 이만.
또 수련이겠지 뭐 is an assumption, not a flat accusation.
'Is anything more important' is tighter spoken English for the same retort.
할 말 없게 만드는군 is being left with no comeback, not being shut up.
SOL omits 말문이 막혀, leaving only the lip-smacking.
'Pierced like awls' is the natural collocation for 송곳처럼 찔렀다.
당황한 얼굴 is flustered, not merely confused.
'Wrong? Of course not' is the natural dismissal of 잘못은 무슨.
SOL drops 정체; they are curious about his identity.
이참에 is 'while we’re at it,' not 'since we’re/you’re here'.
decisions.replacement: “While we’re at it, why don’t you introduce yourselves? This is Cheongpung.”

decisions.reason: 'Bowed deeply' is more natural than 'gave a deep bow'.
'The hell' adds profanity the Korean does not have.
'Written all over their faces' is the idiomatic rendering of 얼굴엔 딱 저렇게 쓰여 있다.
간단명료하게 is simply and clearly, not 'as simply as possible'.
Drops BASE’s unsupported 'instant' while keeping 치트키.
'Gaped... too stunned to speak' captures 입을 딱 벌리고 말을 잇지 못하자 more cleanly.
'Still reeling from the shock' is natural for 충격에서 빠져나오지 못한.
The line has both 검성 and 대협; BASE drops Great Hero and SOL drops Sword Saint.
decisions.replacement: “I-I’m the Heaven Shaking Sword. But are you really the Sword Saint, Great Hero Mae Jonghak’s…?”

decisions.reason: 알려진 is known to have gone into seclusion, not merely believed.
The 라니 fragment is an astonished noun phrase, not a complete 'He’s…' clause.
The source fills the 목소리 with 기대, not the question with hope.
Keeps 검객 and lands 신이나 다름없는 at the end, matching the Korean close.
기대를 산산조각 냈다 is shattered expectations, not hopes.
'I snuck out alone' is tighter for 저만 몰래 도망쳐 나왔어요.
The two sentence joins are indistinguishable.
반짝거리는 is gleaming, and 'for some time now' fits 아까 전부터.
Restores 진천검, which BASE omitted from the address.
'I am' matches the slightly formal 내가 진무경이오.
'I’ve been searching' fits 찾아 헤맸 better than a simple past.
Keeps the reveal order: the person he was seeking was Jin Mukyung.
SOL drops 물었다; both men asked, they did not only look bewildered.
나쁘지 않겠다 is a decent start, not a good one.
첫 번째라니 echoes 'first,' not the English word 'start'.
비무행 is the bare term; SOL adds unsupported 'My'.
잔잔하게 is a soft smile, and 전혀 다른 종류 is a completely different kind.
하산하면서 is while coming down the mountain, not after he had come down.
BASE weakens 겨룰; SOL replaces 대화 with 'words'.
decisions.replacement: “My grandfather told me this: A martial artist has no need for conversation. We contend through martial arts alone.”

decisions.reason: SOL drops 솟구친/피어오르고; BASE already renders the heat faithfully.
이미 is 'already'; SOL omits it.
그을렸다 is scorched, and SOL drops 입을 열었다 as the manner of speaking.
A period is the correct break before the next-paragraph line of dialogue.
The insert splits the beat and turns 길게 숨을 내뱉었다 into 'exhaled slowly'.
Keeps the full four-sentence beat, including the long breath and 'important,' not 'crucial'.
손을 올리며 is placing a hand on the hilt, not resting one there.
SOL’s 'not a single day had passed... that he had forgotten' is tangled; 'not once' is clean and faithful.
Dropping 'who was' tightens the same sentence.
'I will' carries the determined 꺾고 말겠다 better than the contraction.
들었다면 is hypothetical 'if,' and 미친놈 is crazy, not insane.
BASE weakens 천재 to 'talented'; SOL rewrites 불리기 시작한 이래 as earning the title.
decisions.replacement: No matter how much of a genius Jin Mukyung was, he could never reach the Sword Saint’s name. Ever since Mae Jonghak had begun to be called the Sword Saint, no one had surpassed him.

decisions.reason: Need 이미 from SOL and 주인공 as protagonist, not hero.
decisions.replacement: Decades ago, Sword Saint Mae Jonghak had already written a new chapter in the history of the orthodox Murim and become the protagonist of a legend.

decisions.reason: 'It was not' matches the emphatic 만용이 아니라 목표다 contrast.
수련하며 is as he trained, not merely 'every day he trained'.
이 순간 is this very moment, not a flattened 'now'.
Integrates the quoted warning more smoothly without changing the wording.
아무렇게나 매인 is tied on haphazardly; SOL leaves only the dangling.
그러나 is 'But,' not 'And yet'.
'Had no idea' is the direct reading of 도무지... 모르겠다.
아니에요 is a complete denial, so a period before 'Honestly' is cleaner.
'Meant every word' and 'made him feel stranger' match 모두 진심 and 기분이 묘했다.
'Only a little?' is the natural English sting of fixating on 살짝.
'Talent and effort had brought him this far' is more natural for 이 자리에 올랐다.
Simple past keeps the titles in the same immediate retrospective list.
'Drunk on empty fame' is the idiomatic rendering of 허명에 취한.
SOL drops 시선; he grew used to people’s gazes.
확신하지 못했어요 is not being certain, not the looser 'sure'.
'Because I met you, Young Hero Jin' is the natural reply to 'Because you met me?'
피식 웃었다 is letting out a quiet laugh, not giving one.
Keeps 놈 as 'guy,' 때 묻지 않은, 혹은 그 이상 as 'even,' and the staccato 순수함/솔직함.
어울리지 않는 is that he didn’t fit; SOL adds 'entirely' and a stiffer register.
한 사람이 is one person, not someone.
Keeps 놈, 것 같은, and 어떻게든, which SOL flattens to 'a man who could probably'.
'I turned twenty this year' is the natural rendering of 올해로 약관입니다.
'Even the same age' captures 나이도, and the fragments match 우연인가? 아니면 인연?
Fronting 'Instead of answering' follows 대답 대신에 고개를 저었다.
전신에서 넘실거리는 is qi surging through his entire body, not merely around him.
'His only regret' matches 아쉬울 뿐이다 more naturally than 'merely regrettable'.
'What would that troublemaker do' is the direct 어떻게 했을까.
SOL’s 'four words' previews 넌. 좆. 됐. 다. before that line lands.
넌 좆됐다 is 'You. Are. Fucked.'; adding 'So' intensifies the line.
끓어오른 is boiling up from the dantian, and 뻗어 나간다 is coursing outward, not surging within.
따위 is 'or anything like that'; SOL drops it.
거대한 굉음과 함께 leads with a tremendous boom, not a thunderous one after the clash.
